meta.name: alfworld-object-storer
meta.description: Use when the agent is holding an object and needs to place it into a target receptacle in ALFWorld. This skill checks receptacle suitability, opens closed containers if needed, and executes the `put` command to store the object. It handles both open surfaces (countertops, beds) and closed containers (drawers, cabinets).

copy.tagline: 把手中物品放入指定容器

copy.tagline_en: Place held object into target receptacle
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically store objects in ALFWorld

howto.what: 当Claude在ALFWorld中拿着物体并需要放入容器时，它会检查容器状态（如是否关闭），必要时打开容器，然后执行放置命令并确认结果。
howto.when: 当Claude在ALFWorld中正拿着一个物体，并且已经识别出目标容器，需要执行最后一步放置操作时触发。

say.note: 触发技能将刀放入抽屉1。
触发技能将手机放在床上。
触发技能将钥匙放入柜子。

howto.what_en: In ALFWorld, when Claude holds an object and needs to place it into a receptacle, it checks the receptacle's state (e.g., closed), opens it if needed, executes the put command, and confirms the placement.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Claude is holding an object in ALFWorld and has identified the target receptacle, needing to perform the final placement step.

say_en.note: Triggers the skill to store the knife in drawer 1.

say_en.text: Put the cellphone on the bed
say_en.note: Triggers the skill to place the cellphone on the bed.

say_en.text: Put the keys in the cabinet
